From Aug 24, 2026 to Aug 31, 2026, HoverKraft shipped 1 release across 1 repository (deploy frequency: 1 release in 7 days).

During this period, activity centered on `docusaurus-theme`, which was the busiest project with 1 release and shipped `docusaurus-theme` version 0.4.1 on Aug 30, 2026. No other repositories recorded releases, so the change surface was limited to the documentation theming layer rather than broader platform components or shared infrastructure patterns.

- `docusaurus-theme` (v0.4.1): Platform engineers and technical contributors can treat this as a focused documentation UI update, which reduces risk compared to simultaneous changes across multiple repos and helps keep adoption work aligned with a single, versioned theme artifact.
- Release cadence (1 release / week): SREs can use the low release count to validate operational expectations (build, publish, and downstream consumption) without the noise of concurrent deployments, making it easier to correlate any issues to a specific repo version.
- Single-repo change scope (`docusaurus-theme` only): Technical contributors benefit from clearer review and rollback boundaries when adopting HoverKraft projects, since the theming update is isolated to one repository and one tagged release.
